chain.normative_source: VERIFIED VERBATIM. Annex A (Interface spec) L229-230 states that when an Evidence carries multi-target measurement results, the text report must show, in addition to the Test-level aggregate, each target's reference, result and count as child elements, and the JSON must return the main-volume 3.7 target-wise list with no omission. The referenced 3.7 list is Detailed Design L448-457 (target_execution: checked / method / result / targets each with target, result, count), and L461-465 requires that with checked true the targets list is 1:1 with the declared canonical target set. Annex A L216 also shows the example tree line target_execution PASS (2/2 targets PASS). Basic Spec 7.10 L509-511 requires the detailed output to let a reader drill into which entity, which item, which value, which basis, in both human text and machine JSON.
chain.mechanism: verify/report build one VerificationReport (crates/vtest-verify/src/lib.rs:70-78) = requested_scope + entity_scope + scope_outside_not_checked + items + tree + result. The per-Test detail node is VerificationNode (lib.rs:61-68) whose payload is Vec<ReportItem> (lib.rs:50-55: item / value / basis as Vec<String>). The same struct is serialized for --format json (crates/vtest-cli/src/lib.rs:2598-2606, serde_json::to_value of the result) and walked by the text renderer print_text_tree_node (crates/vtest-cli/src/lib.rs:3936-3963). report is literally run_verify with summary=false (crates/vtest-cli/src/lib.rs:378-383), and the MCP verify/report tools forward to the same CLI (crates/vtest-mcp/src/lib.rs:1371-1394), so this is the only report surface (vtest --help lists init/scan/doctor/spec/req/vo/test/audit/run/verify/report/mcp; no evidence-inspection command).
chain.condition: A Test declaring two targets (@vtest.kind integration plus two @vtest.target lines; multi-target requires the integration kind per crates/vtest-adapter-rust/src/discovery.rs:1026-1035) whose Evidence carries a measured multi-target target_execution: checked true, method llvm-cov, targets = [known: PASS count 3, second: PASS count 1]. This is exactly the antecedent of Annex A L229, and it is the shape the product's own writer emits: coverage_target_execution (crates/vtest-adapter-rust/src/runner.rs:200-223, called at runner.rs:702) maps every declared target to one TargetExecutionObservation with target, result, count (crates/vtest-model/src/lib.rs:790-805).
chain.impl_path: crates/vtest-verify/src/lib.rs:1648-1682 evaluate_target_execution reads only record.target_execution.result (the aggregate) and pushes exactly ONE basis string per Test via evidence_basis (lib.rs:1753-1763), formatted as Test <id>: <value> (Evidence <id>, log_ref <ref>). record.target_execution.targets is never read on this path; its only read anywhere in verify is lib.rs:988, the DA-002 static-audit rescue join, which emits no report output. test_node (lib.rs:489-503) attaches the seven item names with children set to an empty Vec, so a Test node has no per-target children. The JSON is the serde image of that same tree; the text renderer prints only item plus value per item and does not even print basis.
chain.expected: Per Annex A L229-230, the text report shows under the Test-level target_execution aggregate one child per target carrying that target's reference, result and count; and the JSON returns the 3.7 target-wise list (target, result, count for each of the two targets) with no omission.
chain.actual: Reproduced on an isolated project: the JSON report returns for the Test node only the item target_execution with value PASS and a single basis string naming the Evidence id and log_ref. No target field, no per-target result, no count appears anywhere in the envelope. The text report prints the row target_execution PASS with no child rows at all. Flipping the second target to result FAIL count 0 changes only the aggregate to FAIL; the failing target's identity is still absent (a scan of the whole serialized envelope for the target name second finds nothing, and diagnostics is empty).
chain.negation: The claim asserts a property of the emitted report, and the emitted report type has no representation for the per-target list, so the negation is structural rather than a local branch omission. (a) Reachability: the antecedent state is producible by the product itself (runner.rs:200-223 writes one observation per declared target under coverage) and is accepted as canonical by the reader (evidence parsed, target_execution evaluated PASS, exit code 0, ok true). (b) No other gate rejects first: the record is not malformed (target entries are 1:1 with the declared targets and the aggregate agrees with the per-target results, so E-SCAN-010 does not fire), evidence_validity does not reject it, and the aggregate reached PASS, meaning the pipeline ran to completion and produced the deficient report as its accepted output. (c) No alternative surface satisfies it: report is the same function as verify, MCP forwards to the same CLI, and no evidence-inspection command exists, so there is nowhere else the 3.7 list could be returned. (d) Both conjuncts of the claim fail, not only the JSON one: the text form also omits the per-target children required by Annex A L229, so the defect cannot be reframed as JSON still being lossless relative to text, since the claim independently requires the complete 3.7 per-target list with no omission. System-level consequence: for a multi-target Test the report cannot say WHICH target failed, which also breaks Basic Spec 7.10 L509 drill-down (NFR-006 explainability).

chain.claim: VO-PLAN-06: 'Coverage audits bind hashes of the complete subject set; after the subject content or correspondence set changes, prior verdicts become STALE and never count as current PASS.' The adequacy entry glosses 'correspondence set' as VO<->Test and alleges the vo-coverage audit fails to bind it.
chain.normative_source: Verified by re-reading the cited docs. (a) 基本仕様 §7.3 (docs/…基本仕様 v0.1.md:404-405): '受理された結果は…監査種別ごとの完全な対象集合と内容ハッシュに束縛される。対象集合またはいずれかの対象内容が変更されると、監査レコードは自動的に STALE となる' — the STALE trigger is scoped to each kind's own 対象集合. (b) 基本仕様 §7.4 (:414-437): for spec-coverage the correspondence set is named explicitly — '対象SPEC、REQ内容、または対応REQ集合が変化した監査は STALE になる'; for vo-coverage it states '監査対象は対応REQとVO部分木であり' — Tests are not in it. (c) 詳細設計 §8.4 (docs/…詳細設計 v0.1.md:1170) is a closed per-kind enumeration: 'vo-coverage では REQ・VO部分木・SPEC subject を含める'. (d) 詳細設計 §8.3 (:1053) deliberately puts '各 leaf VO の covers 状況' in the bundle CONTENTS list, distinguished from subjects. (e) 詳細設計 §11.1 (:1335) assigns VO<->Test to a DIFFERENT check item: 'test_existence | leaf VO | covers する Test が1件以上あれば PASS、なければ MISSING'. (f) 要件定義 §6 (:332-371), the VO's own cited ref, is decisive on the word 'correspondence': 'Specification または Requirement との対応関係が変化した後も、以前の判定を無条件に現在の PASS として扱ってはならない' — SPEC/REQ, never Test. (g) 別紙C §18.2 likewise lists only 'Specification source または上流REQの変更によって無効になる spec-coverage Audit / Approval'. No normative text anywhere makes the covering-Test set a vo-coverage subject.
chain.mechanism: Two separate mechanisms by design. (1) Audit-bound freshness: a vo-coverage audit record stores `subjects` (REQ + VO subtree + SPEC) and is re-validated at verify time by hash; a changed/absent subject makes it STALE and it cannot count as a current PASS (詳細設計 §8.5). (2) Live structural coverage: `test_existence` is recomputed from the current scan on every verify — it is not audit-bound at all, so it cannot go stale-fail-open. vo-coverage answers 'is the REQ->VO decomposition complete?'; test_existence answers 'does each leaf VO have a covering Test?'.
chain.condition: Isolated project (calc/m1/base fixture): REQ-VP06 -> VO-KNOWN (leaf) <- TEST-M1-CLEAN. vo-coverage audit submitted COMPLETE, VO approved, audit regenerated post-approval => vo_coverage = PASS. Trigger: add TEST-VP06-EXTRA covering the same VO-KNOWN (the VO<->Test correspondence set changes from {TEST-M1-CLEAN} to {TEST-M1-CLEAN, TEST-VP06-EXTRA}), without touching any REQ/VO/SPEC content. Also exercised the stronger fail-open direction: delete every covering Test.
chain.impl_path: crates/vtest-cli/src/lib.rs:1298-1414 (kind == "vo-coverage" bundle build): `subjects` receives subject_value("vo", …), subject_value("req", …), subject_value("spec", …); `leaf_coverage` (:1390-1405) is computed from scan.tests and emitted as a sibling bundle field, not pushed into `subjects`. crates/vtest-verify/src/lib.rs:1265-1348 evaluate_vo_coverage -> parse_audit_subjects (:1454) -> subject_is_current (:1559): each recorded subject is re-hashed; approval is checked live via vo_is_approved. crates/vtest-verify/src/lib.rs:599 dispatches "vo_coverage"; `test_existence` is evaluated independently from the live scan.
chain.expected: Per the candidate's reading: adding a Test that covers the audited VO changes the 'correspondence set', so the prior vo-coverage record must become STALE and vo_coverage must drop off PASS. Per the actual normative text: vo-coverage subjects are REQ + VO subtree + SPEC only, so the record must stay current and PASS, while VO<->Test correspondence is judged by test_existence.
chain.actual: Observed (isolated repro, prebuilt target/debug/vtest): after adding TEST-VP06-EXTRA, `verify --items vo_coverage,test_existence` reported `vo_coverage PASS ['VO VO-KNOWN: Pass (coverage audits: 01M02RX7BB…, 01M02RXGRE…)']` — neither record marked '(stale)' — and `test_existence PASS ['all 1 leaf VO(s) have a covering Test']`. A freshly generated bundle confirmed the split exactly as the spec prescribes: `leaf_coverage = [{"vo":"VO-KNOWN","tests":["TEST-M1-CLEAN","TEST-VP06-EXTRA"]}]` while `subjects = [{kind:vo,id:VO-KNOWN},{kind:req,id:REQ-VP06}]`. So the candidate's code reading is factually accurate.
chain.negation: It does NOT negate the claim. The candidate is refuted at point (2), not point (7): it misidentifies the normative premise. 'Correspondence set' in VO-PLAN-06 traces, via the VO's own refs, to SPEC<->REQ (spec-coverage's 対応REQ集合) and REQ<->VO部分木 (vo-coverage's 対応REQとVO部分木) — 要件定義 §6 names Specification and Requirement and nothing else, and 詳細設計 §8.4:1170 is a closed enumeration that excludes Tests while §8.3:1053 places leaf covers-status in bundle content precisely so the auditor can read it without it becoming a freshness subject. The implementation therefore matches the spec rather than violating it. Reinforcing point 8 at SYSTEM level: no false current PASS is reachable from this trigger, because the VO<->Test concern is owned by a live, non-audit-bound gate — deleting every covering Test yielded `test_existence MISSING ['leaf VO(s) have no covering Test: VO-KNOWN']` while vo_coverage correctly stayed PASS, i.e. the fail-open the candidate posits is caught by the item the spec assigns to it. Adding a Test is a strict widening of coverage and, per §7.4/§7.6, cannot invalidate a decomposition-completeness judgment in any case.

chain.claim: A detected spec/VO/Test vs implementation inconsistency is presented as check value MISMATCH — including the no-audit ambiguous-resolution case — and the impl_consistency presentation never determines which artifact should be fixed.
chain.normative_source: Verified verbatim. 基本仕様 §7.5 (docs/AI並列開発向けテスト検証システム 基本仕様 v0.1.md:440-447): 「targetを一意に解決できない場合はバンドルを生成せず、候補のいずれも選択しない。対象が存在しない場合は`MISSING`、複数候補により曖昧な場合は`MISMATCH`とする。」/「不一致は `MISMATCH` として提示し、どちらを修正すべきかは決定しない。」/「監査の未実施・失効・判定不能は、それぞれ`NOT_CHECKED`・`STALE`・`UNKNOWN`として保持し、不一致と混同しない。」 要件定義 §13 (:533-545) 「不一致を検出した場合、MISMATCH として提示する。どちらを修正すべきかは決定しない。」 詳細設計 §8.1 (:1056) 「記録する`impl_consistency`は解決失敗の種別で分ける。対象が存在しない場合（E-SCAN-004…）は`MISSING`、恒久SRC IDの衝突により複数候補で曖昧な場合（E-SCAN-011）は`MISMATCH`とする」 詳細設計 §11.1 表 (:1339) impl_consistency 「…対象シンボル不在はMISSING、曖昧な解決（E-SCAN-011）はMISMATCH」。Both the basic spec and the detailed design bind the ambiguous-resolution case to the impl_consistency CHECK VALUE, not merely to a scan diagnostic.
chain.mechanism: Deterministic target resolution is a bundle-generation gate: an ambiguous target must (a) block bundle generation, (b) select no candidate, (c) surface on the impl_consistency check item as MISMATCH (曖昧/E-SCAN-011) or MISSING (対象不在/E-SCAN-004), kept distinct from NOT_CHECKED which is reserved for 監査未実施.
chain.condition: A managed Test whose declared target resolves to more than one candidate. Grep over crates/vtest-verify/src/*.rs finds no compat / rust-cargo-inference path at all — the compat branch does not exist. The value feeds evaluate_evidence_validity / evaluate_test_execution (:1700-1748) and is folded into the report item.
chain.expected: branch (a): evaluated as compat Evidence; remaining freshness conditions all hold -> evidence_validity = PASS. branch (b) (adapter-less, Rust execution not uniquely confirmable): evidence_validity = UNKNOWN.
chain.actual: CheckValue::Stale in both branches, unconditionally, decided solely on the absence of the field and before any content-hash or runner-info evidence is consulted. The value distinction is load-bearing: 基本仕語 §4.3 fixes the representative-value priority FAIL > MISMATCH > MISSING > STALE > NOT_EXECUTED > NOT_CHECKED > UNKNOWN, and the report exposes the fixed 12 items (§4.2), so the concrete label is contract surface, not cosmetic.

chain.claim: When multiple non-PASS child values coexist, the representative value displayed at the parent is exactly the highest-priority value per the fixed order FAIL>MISMATCH>MISSING>STALE>NOT_EXECUTED>NOT_CHECKED>UNKNOWN.
chain.normative_source: Verified in the doc itself. 基本仕様 v0.1 §4.3 (docs/AI並列開発向けテスト検証システム 基本仕様 v0.1.md:220): 「集約時に複数の非 PASS 値が混在する場合、上位に表示する代表値の優先順位は `FAIL > MISMATCH > MISSING > STALE > NOT_EXECUTED > NOT_CHECKED > UNKNOWN` とする。詳細出力では子の個別値をすべて確認できる。」 The order is stated unconditionally, with no carve-out for any input class. Corroborating: 詳細設計 v0.1 §3.6 (line 422) prescribes that when no non-malformed valid static Audit Record remains, `static_audit` is STALE or NOT_CHECKED — it never authorises UNKNOWN for a malformed record; 別紙C line 100 only requires that a malformed record supply no valid PASS. UNKNOWN is the MINIMUM of the fixed order (基本仕様 line 187 table), so under any assignment of a value to a malformed input, §4.3 forbids UNKNOWN from being the representative whenever any other non-PASS value coexists.
chain.mechanism: crates/vtest-verify/src/lib.rs::combine_values (1854-1876) is the single implementation of the §4.3 order (rank Fail=8 … NotChecked=3, Unknown=2, Pass=1, PASS-absorbing). evaluate_static_audit (691-855) folds one per-Test CheckValue into `project_value` with combine_values, accumulating a human-readable `basis` ground per contributor; that folded value is the static_audit item value reported at the parent (project/Test rows and the scoped `Result:` line).
chain.condition: A project with (a) at least one registered Test contributing a non-PASS static_audit value strictly above UNKNOWN in the order — NOT_CHECKED (never audited) or STALE (only subject-stale records) — and (b) at least one file in `.verify/audits/` that fails typed AuditRecord parsing while its raw YAML carries top-level `kind: static`, whose text mentions no registered Test ID (an 'unassociated malformed static record'). Both grounds then coexist as separate entries in the same basis list.
chain.impl_path: crates/vtest-verify/src/lib.rs:706-725 (unparseable `kind: static` files are collected into `malformed`) → 729-822 (per-Test values folded into `project_value` via combine_values) → 828-854: `let unassociated_malformed = malformed.iter().filter(|(_,_,text)| !scan.tests.iter().any(|t| audit_text_mentions_test(text, t.id.as_str())))`; then `if !unassociated_malformed.is_empty() { if project_value != CheckValue::Fail { project_value = CheckValue::Unknown; } ... }`. combine_values is bypassed entirely on this path.
chain.expected: Per §4.3 the parent must display the highest-priority coexisting non-PASS value: STALE when a Test contributes STALE alongside the malformed record's UNKNOWN-flavoured ground, and NOT_CHECKED when the Test contributes NOT_CHECKED. The malformed ground remains visible in the detail output (basis), which is exactly what §4.3's second sentence provides for.
chain.actual: The parent displays UNKNOWN in both cases. Observed on an isolated scratch project: with a stale valid record the item is STALE (basis: ["Test TEST-DEMO-1: Stale; 1 stale record(s) ignored"]); dropping one unparseable `kind: static` file into `.verify/audits/` flips the same item to UNKNOWN while the basis still lists both grounds (["Test TEST-DEMO-1: Stale; 1 stale record(s) ignored", "1 malformed static audit record(s) could not be assigned to a registered Test: A-BROKEN-1 (...)"]). The same flip occurs from NOT_CHECKED → UNKNOWN with no audit record for the Test.
chain.negation: Decisive at SYSTEM level. (1) The override is not a local omission: it replaces the result of the very fold that implements §4.3, after that fold has already produced the correct representative, and it is unconditional except for a single hand-rolled FAIL carve-out (`if project_value != CheckValue::Fail`). The implementation therefore applies a truncated 2-level order (FAIL > UNKNOWN > everything else) in place of the normative 7-level order — MISMATCH, MISSING, STALE, NOT_EXECUTED and NOT_CHECKED are all collapsed to UNKNOWN, the order's minimum. (2) No spec-gap escape exists: because UNKNOWN is the lowest-priority value in the fixed order, there is NO value assignment to the malformed input under which §4.3 permits UNKNOWN as the representative while a STALE or NOT_CHECKED child coexists. Whether the malformed record is read as an UNKNOWN child (the code's own comment: 'is still an unknown input to this item') or as contributing nothing at all, the mandated representative is STALE / NOT_CHECKED, never UNKNOWN. (3) No other gate rejects the state first: the state is trivially reachable (any unreadable YAML file declaring `kind: static` under `.verify/audits/`), `verify` does not refuse to run on it, and it does not surface it as a scan error — it completes normally and emits the wrong representative (exit 1, NG). (4) Both the per-Test item row and the scoped `Result:` line show the wrong representative, so the defect reaches the user-facing report, which is what VO-AGG-03 constrains. Fail-closed is preserved (both values are non-PASS), but VO-AGG-03's claim is about representative selection, not about PASS promotion, and that claim is negated. Secondary instance of the same defect: line 789-790 assigns CheckValue::Unknown when a Test has a malformed record, whereas 詳細設計 §3.6 line 422 prescribes STALE/NOT_CHECKED for that case.

chain.condition: A project containing (i) an active REQ with at least one VO whose vo-coverage audit is current/COMPLETE and whose approval is valid (so the VO-side is PASS), and (ii) a second active REQ record with zero VOs referencing it. Then run the normatively supported item-scoped verification `vtest verify --items vo_coverage`. ScopeSelection has no status filter and a fresh REQ is active by default, so reachability is unaffected by the active/deprecated distinction.

chain.mechanism: The rust-cargo adapter measures llvm-cov counts per declared target, emits one TargetExecutionObservation per target (PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN), folds them into the Test-level aggregate, and persists both the per-target list and the aggregate into the Evidence record's target_execution. vtest-exec writes the adapter's TargetExecution verbatim into the EvidenceRecord; vtest-verify's evaluate_target_execution reports the stored aggregate as the target_execution check item, which then aggregates up Test -> VO -> REQ -> SPEC by 基本仕様 §4.3 priority.
chain.condition: One Test declaring two targets where the per-target results are mixed FAIL + UNKNOWN: target A is compiled into the instrumented binary but never called (llvm-cov count 0 -> FAIL), target B is not present in the llvm-cov export (cfg-excluded / inlined / uninstantiated generic — the exact case 詳細設計 §10.2 labels '関数が見つからない → UNKNOWN（インライン化・cfg 除外等の可能性）'). Multi-target declaration is admitted for @vtest.kind integration-* (crates/vtest-scan/src/lib.rs:2039-2077); unit kinds reject a second @vtest.target with E-SCAN-005.
chain.impl_path: crates/vtest-adapter-rust/src/runner.rs:224-237 (coverage_target_execution fold) -> crates/vtest-adapter-rust/src/runner.rs:702 (call site in the non-fast coverage run) -> crates/vtest-exec/src/lib.rs:184 (target_execution: observation.target_execution, stored verbatim) -> crates/vtest-store/src/records.rs:1188 (reader parses the stored result scalar verbatim) -> crates/vtest-verify/src/lib.rs:1664-1673 (evaluate_target_execution returns record.target_execution.result unchanged when evidence_validity == PASS).
chain.expected: With per-target results {FAIL, UNKNOWN}, the Test-level target_execution must be FAIL (FAIL dominates UNKNOWN), so the persisted Evidence aggregate and the verify target_execution item must both read FAIL, and FAIL must be the representative value carried upward.
chain.actual: The fold at runner.rs:224-237 tests UNKNOWN before FAIL: `if observations.is_empty() || observations.iter().any(|o| o.result == Unknown) { Unknown } else if ... any(Fail) { Fail } else { Pass }`. Any UNKNOWN therefore masks every FAIL. Reproduced end-to-end with the shipped binary: run --all persisted `target_execution: {checked: true, result: UNKNOWN, targets: [{never_called, FAIL, count 0}, {ghost, UNKNOWN, count null}]}` with zero diagnostics, and verify reported `target_execution UNKNOWN` with `evidence_validity PASS`.
chain.negation: System level, not local. (a) The value that the spec names is the value the system persists and prints: verify's target_execution item is UNKNOWN where 基本仕様 §7.9 and 詳細設計 §10.2 mandate FAIL — the observed output directly negates the claim's fold precedence, with evidence_validity PASS so nothing is discounted as STALE. (b) The direction of the error is a fail-open severity demotion under 基本仕様 §4.3: a determinate defect (a declared target proven never executed, count 0) is reported as the weakest representative value instead of the strongest, so the upward roll-up differs — the observed run printed `Result: MISSING` with the Test node NOT_CHECKED, whereas the spec-mandated FAIL would dominate §4.3 and surface as FAIL at Test/VO/overall level. (c) Reachability gate checked, not assumed: unit-kind multi-target is rejected by E-SCAN-005, but @vtest.kind integration-normal legitimately admits two targets (scan OK, tests:1, no E-SCAN-004 for the cfg-excluded target), and the UNKNOWN branch is the one the design itself anticipates. (d) No downstream gate repairs or rejects it: vtest-exec stores the adapter value verbatim (lib.rs:184), the store reader takes the stored result scalar verbatim (records.rs:1188), verify passes it through (lib.rs:1667-1672), and the only fold-consistency check in the store — pure_static_fold (records.rs:977-989, which correctly puts FAIL first) — governs static Audit records' per-target verdicts, not Evidence target_execution, so no malformed check catches the inconsistency. (e) Not an intended deviation: the function's own doc comment (runner.rs:196-199) states the spec order ('the aggregate is FAIL if any target was never called, UNKNOWN if any is unattributable, else PASS'), which the code contradicts, and 基本仕様 §7.9 / 詳細設計 §10.2 admit only one reading, so no NEEDS-SPEC-JUDGMENT branch survives.

Full verify shows spec_coverage=PASS and vo_decomposition=PASS (basis: "scan and canonical VO records are structurally readable"). `verify --items vo_decomposition,spec_coverage --vo VO-KNOWN --format json` returns "result":"PASS", ok:true, diagnostics:[], exit 0 — while both REQ-1 and VO-KNOWN cite a SPEC record that does not exist on disk. chain.normative_source: LOAD-BEARING: 詳細設計 v0.1 §11.3 (docs/AI並列開発向けテスト検証システム 詳細設計 v0.1.md L1434), verbatim: 「runtime 証明に依存する `static_audit` の値は、根拠として用いた Evidence ID と当該 target の target_execution 結果を report で引用する。限定 scope で内部依存の STALE / 非充足が `static_audit` の非 PASS を生む場合も、その内部依存状態を根拠として提示し、scope 外項目の表示値（NOT_CHECKED）だけでは原因を辿れない状態にしない。」 CORROBORATION: 別紙A L243 「`verify` と同じ集約を実行し、根拠（監査レコード ID・Evidence ID・診断）を含む完全な詳細を出力する」; 別紙C §18.3.2 bullet 「表示scopeと内部依存評価を分離する…scope外の`target_execution`/`evidence_validity`自体のreport valueは`NOT_CHECKED`のまま保持する」 plus the bullets making target_execution FAIL/UNKNOWN/NOT_CHECKED a 到達要件未充足. Both doc sections re-read directly; the citation wording exists in 詳細設計 §11.3 and 別紙A L243, so the claim is not invented by the ontology.
chain.mechanism: §7.3/§11.3 design: static_audit cross-depends on Evidence freshness (§11.2) and the per-target target_execution. A per-target DA-002 UNKNOWN counts as reachability-satisfied only when the §11.2-selected Evidence is valid and that target's target_execution is PASS with count>0. Because these dependencies are evaluated internally while their own report values stay NOT_CHECKED under a limited scope, the design compensates by requiring the derivation's ground (Evidence ID + per-target target_execution result, or the STALE/unsatisfied internal state) to be quoted in the report basis — that basis is the only surface where a user can trace the cause.
chain.condition: Limited scope `vtest verify|report --items static_audit` on a project with one registered Test declaring one target, one current (non-stale, store-validated, per-target-carrying) static Audit Record whose DA-002 per-target verdict is UNKNOWN and every other rule PASS, and no Evidence record for that Test (target_execution non-satisfaction). Per §7.3 the DA-002 reachability contribution then stays UNKNOWN because the runtime dependency was evaluated and not satisfied, so static_audit = UNKNOWN. Symmetrically, the rescued-PASS condition is the same record plus a valid Evidence whose per-target target_execution is PASS.
chain.impl_path: crates/vtest-verify/src/lib.rs: evaluate_static_audit basis assembly (L802-822 — `detail = format!("Test {test_id}: {value:?}")` + "(current static audit record(s): …)" + stale/malformed counts, pushed into `basis`); static_audit_item_value (L~1005-1045) returns a bare `CheckValue`; runtime_target_reached (L~972-993) returns `bool`, discarding the EvidenceRecord and the matched target observation; `ReportItem { item, value, basis }` (L49-55) and `VerificationNode` (L61-67) — item_copies/test_node only clone the same ReportItem, so basis strings are the sole carrier; verify_project_scoped (L107-150) fills non-scoped items with basis "outside requested scope". crates/vtest-cli/src/lib.rs L2572 and L378-383: both `verify` and `report` call verify_project_scoped and serialize the whole VerificationResult, so the emitted JSON is exactly these strings.
chain.expected: Per §11.3 the limited-scope report must present the internal-dependency state as the ground for the static_audit non-PASS (e.g. "target rust-cargo::src/lib.rs::known: DA-002 UNKNOWN, no valid Evidence / target_execution NOT_EXECUTED"), and a runtime-rescued value must quote the Evidence ID and that target's target_execution result.
chain.actual: Observed limited-scope output: static_audit UNKNOWN with basis exactly ["Test TEST-M1-CLEAN: Unknown (current static audit record(s): 01M02SF44413GJ1D0003TM0000)"]; target_execution NOT_CHECKED ["outside requested scope"]; evidence_validity NOT_CHECKED ["outside requested scope"]; diagnostics []. Case-insensitive grep over the whole report JSON finds "evidence" only as the item name `evidence_validity` — never an Evidence ID, never a target_execution result. The tree node for TEST-M1-CLEAN carries the identical basis string. On the rescued path the same format string yields "Test TEST-M1-CLEAN: Pass (current static audit record(s): …)" (observed by flipping the per-target DA-002 to PASS): no Evidence ID on any value.
chain.negation: System level, not a local omission. (1) The state is reachable and no other gate rejects it: the record passes AuditRecord::from_yaml static validation (DA-001..DA-006 exactly once, record verdict == derived fold) and static_record_target_defect (per-target set == declared canonical set, rule verdict == pure_static_fold), is subject-current (not STALE), carries per-target DA-002/DA-003, and verify emitted zero diagnostics and a normal UNKNOWN rather than an error. (2) The non-PASS is caused solely by the internal dependency: flipping only the DA-002 per-target verdict to PASS (fold kept consistent) turns static_audit to PASS, so the UNKNOWN is entirely the §7.3 reachability contribution, UNKNOWN only because runtime_target_reached() returned false for the absent Evidence — precisely the 内部依存の非充足 §11.3 names. (3) The report is the only normative citation surface (basis strings; tree nodes are clones; diagnostics empty; `report` is the same code path as `verify`), and it structurally cannot carry the citation because runtime_target_reached returns bool and static_audit_item_value returns a bare CheckValue — the Evidence record and the per-target observation are dropped before any string is built. What ships to the user is therefore exactly the state §11.3 forbids: the cause is traceable only from scope-external NOT_CHECKED values. Both conjuncts fail — the second reproduced live, the first by deterministic derivation over a single unconditional format string.
